test_dataframe_unique: test the DataFrame.unique() method to deduplicate rows by all columns or a subset with maintain_order and keep options
test_series_unique: test the Series.unique() method to deduplicate values and preserve nulls with maintain_order parameter
test_lazyframe_unique_predicate_pushdown: test LazyFrame.unique() with predicate pushdown to verify filter operations are not naively pushed past unique
test_unique_keep_none: test DataFrame.unique() with keep='none' to remove all duplicate rows and keep only unique values
test_unique_with_expression_subset: test unique() with expression-based subset including pl.col(), pl.exclude(), cs selectors, and string operations
